items: Report: **SPARK: Patent Trends Update in GenAI** (WIPO)
India: 5th globally; 64% CAGR (2024–2025); published 929 patents in 2024-25 alone (~70% of the 1,350 filed in the entire 2014-2023 decade)
Rankings: **China — 43,383 patents (#1)** → USA (10% share) → Japan (6.5%) → South Korea (3.7%); India's global share: 2%
